issue: Coordinate diagram can confuse row/column with x/y.
correction: Use image[y,x], with x column, y row; OpenCV points use (x,y).
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Prose describes cv.imshow/waitKey but displayed code uses Matplotlib.
correction: The reconstructed example saves a Matplotlib figure; GUI calls are a separate alternative.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Comment describes5x5 blur while code uses31x31.
correction: Record actual example as31x31; Task05 independently requests25x25.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Text scale in code/prose differs.
correction: Reconstructed example uses a documented visible scale1.5; preserve original scan for exact original constant.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Threshold maxval200 is described as pure white.
correction: uint8 white is255;200 is a lighter gray although auto-scaled plots may show it white.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: cv.add is presented as image blending.
correction: cv.add is saturating addition; cv.addWeighted with complementary weights implements alpha blending.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Scale0.8 at45degrees assumed to prevent cropping.
correction: For a square,0.8*sqrt(2)>1; expand canvas or use a smaller scale if preserving all content.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Enlarge by300percent is ambiguous.
correction: Default interprets final size300percent (3x); strict increase by300percent means4x. Both are documented.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Physical PDF page order reverses exercise groups.
correction: Canonical task order1..10 maps to physical pages3,2,1. All references use physical PDF pages.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Homogeneous notation motivates sweeping performance claims about vector addition/GPU cost.
correction: The reliable benefit here is unified representation and composition; speed depends on implementation and hardware.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Signed atan2 angles are histogrammed over positive-only ranges.
correction: Wrap angles modulo360 or180 before binning; otherwise negative angles are discarded.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: HED creates a Canny map but histograms all gradient orientations.
correction: Restrict to selected edge pixels for an edge-direction histogram, and document weighting.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Histogram normalization implies scale invariance.
correction: Normalization reduces dependence on sample count/overall weighting; it does not generally make texture spatially scale invariant.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: High sum-of-squared intensity energy is equated to complex texture.
correction: Uniform white has high intensity energy and zero contrast; distinguish brightness energy from variation.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: uint8 squared intensities overflow, output may saturate, and contrast code sums pixels.
correction: Convert to float before squaring; local standard deviation=sqrt(max(E[I²]-E[I]²,0)).
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: A getGaussianKernel column is used as if a full2D blur.
correction: Use outer product v@v.T or sepFilter2D with both directions.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: filter2D same-size output is labeled full/valid; reflected borders called zero padding.
correction: Explicitly pad for full, crop for valid, use BORDER_CONSTANT for zero padding; same describes shape, not border rule.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: filter2D is passed strides=(2,2), an unsupported argument.
correction: Filter then subsample explicit valid output, or use another operation that actually exposes stride.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: filter2D called convolution without the correlation distinction.
correction: Flip an asymmetric kernel in both axes for true convolution.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Sobel-Feldman described as a separate directional variation.
correction: Sobel-Feldman is the Sobel operator name; derivative directions are selected explicitly.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Non-maximum suppression described only as eliminating weak pixels.
correction: NMS keeps local maxima along gradient direction; hysteresis thresholds then select connected edges.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Region-growth coordinate names differ from OpenCV point convention.
correction: Bundled API consistently accepts(x,y), indexes[y,x], checks seed, and marks queued coordinates visited.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Boundary [255,0,0] called red in a BGR array; Matplotlib display is unconverted.
correction: BGR red=(0,0,255), followed by BGR2RGB when plotting. Display conversion and array convention must agree.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: K-means BGR array sent directly to Matplotlib.
correction: Convert BGR to RGB for plotting; retain BGR for subsequent OpenCV operations.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Absolute LoG image can be mistaken for zero-crossing edges.
correction: Preserve signed response and explicitly detect sign changes for zero-crossing localization.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Slope/intercept line description omits vertical-line limitation.
correction: OpenCV polar Hough uses rho/theta, covering vertical lines without infinite slope.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Illustration small text says120-dimensional while grid is4x4x8.
correction: Standard SIFT descriptor is128-dimensional.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: descriptors.shape accessed unconditionally.
correction: No keypoints may return descriptors=None; guard before shape/matching.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Line boundaries/brightness alone treated as enough for screen missing/on-off status.
correction: Require expected layout and report visual evidence; missing vs occluded and dark vs powered-off are distinct.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Intensity colorization can be read as blood-flow information.
correction: JET of grayscale carries only intensity; it is not measured Doppler velocity.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Fusion can be attempted without explicit registration.
correction: Require already registered corresponding slices; resizing alone is insufficient.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved

issue: Lab Manual06 filename has a cover labeled Lab05.
correction: Keep the supplied filename identity lab_manual_06; map its wavelet/edge/Hough/SIFT content to the supplied Lab06 tasks, and preserve the cover discrepancy.
status: curated technical correction; original source preserved
